title: Equality of the two normalized stratum evaluation pairings
statement: Use the canonical data and notation of [def-sf-stratum-hom-comparison-data]. Let A be a finite commutative ring, X a Noetherian scheme, c:S to V a closed immersion, v:V to X an open immersion with qc composite, and z the supplied locally closed exceptional comparison [lem-weil-finite-duality-locally-closed-comparison]. For arbitrary P in D(S_e,A), bounded constructible M on X_e, arbitrary normalized natural isomorphisms chi_e and chi_p, and a D+ witness for K=H_e(P,J_e M), the equality is beta_(Q_e P,M) followed by H_p(Delta_P inverse,1) followed by chi_p = C_X(chi_e) followed by the specified ordinary direct-image mate on K followed by R s_p(H_p(1,gamma_M) beta_(P,J_e M)). This is an equality of the specified arrows, including the canonical exact/derived compatibility maps. No existence of chi, proof of boundedness, or invertibility conclusion is asserted.

proof.text: Uncurry the etale normalization after chi_e. Naturality of projection and chi_e followed by its inverse identify ambient evaluation with projection, extended stratum evaluation and the exceptional counit.

The fixed ordinary mate counit equation, transported from D+ to the unbounded factorized exact pullback presentation, identifies the ordinary adjunct of R s_p(d) b_s C_X(chi_e). The evaluation definition of beta and naturality of tensor identify its pairing with gamma C_S(t).

Uncurry the pro-etale normalization and precompose with tensor of the extension comparison Delta. Conjugate the immersion projection-comparison square by the exact/derived extension isomorphisms. On D+ the conjugated Delta equals the specified locally closed comparison by closed-immersion normalization and exact-derived compatibility. Move Delta past t by naturality, then apply the supplied exceptional counit equation. This is comparison of ambient etale evaluation. Tensor-Hom transposition is injective; cancel Delta and compose by chi_p.

theorem normalizedComparisonIdentity
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {S V X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (c : S ⟶ V) (v : V ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion c] [IsOpenImmersion v] [QuasiCompact (c ≫ v)]
    (z : AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.LocallyClosedExceptionalComparison A c v)
    (P : Etale.D A S) (M : AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.BoundedConstructibleDerivedCategory A X)
    (χe : Etale.HomIso A c v z.adjoints) (χp : ProEtale.HomIso A c v z.adjoints)
    (he : Etale.Normalized A c v z.adjoints χe)
    (hp : ProEtale.Normalized A c v z.adjoints χp)
    (hK : DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.plus
      (Etale.hom A S P ((z.adjoints.etaleRight v).obj M.obj))) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.siteComparisonEvaluationHom (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X
        ((AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.locallyClosedEtaleExtension A c v).obj P) M.obj ≫
      homChange A c v P M.obj ≫
      χp.hom.app (op ((ImmersionProjectionComparison.comparison A S).obj P),
        (ImmersionProjectionComparison.comparison A X).obj M.obj) =
      (ImmersionProjectionComparison.comparison A X).map (χe.hom.app (op P, M.obj)) ≫
        directImageMate A (c ≫ v) ⟨_, hK⟩ ≫
        (AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (c ≫ v)
          ).rightDerivedFunctor.map (stratumMap A c v z P M)
